original: 어서오세요./10d 우리 주점의 술맛은 세계 제일입니다.

notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.

original: 우리마을에는 유명한 여의사 에스메랄다 님이 살고 계신답니다.
chinese_reference: 我们村里住着一位著名的女医生，埃斯梅拉达。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The famous physician Esmeralda lives in our village.

original: 우리 주점은 산골짜기에서 나는 광천수로 술을 만들기 때문에 그 어느 곳에서도...
chinese_reference: 我们酒馆用山谷里的矿泉水酿酒，所以不管到哪里……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: We brew our drinks with mineral water from the mountain valleys, so nowhere else...

original: [ 조지 ] /n어서오십시오. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?
chinese_reference: [ 乔治 ] /n欢迎光临。有什么可以帮您？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.

original: 저희 가게를 이용해 주셔서 감사합니다. 다음에 또 오세요.
chinese_reference: 感谢惠顾本店。欢迎下次再来。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Thank you for shopping with us. Please come again.

original: [ 미스 바튼 ]/n 어서오세요, 저희는 반지 전문 입니다.
chinese_reference: [ 巴顿小姐 ]/n欢迎光临，我们专营戒指。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: [ Miss Barton ]/n Welcome. We specialize in rings.

original: [ 헤이든 양 ]/n어서오세요. 저희 여관에 오신것을 환영합니다. 저희 여관의 가격은 95ELD입니다. 묵으시겠습니까?
chinese_reference: [ 海登小姐 ]/n欢迎光临。欢迎来到本旅馆。住宿费为95 ELD。您要住下吗？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: [ Miss Hayden ]/nHello. Welcome to our inn. A room costs 95 ELD. Would you like to stay?

original: 저희 여관을 이용해 주셔서 감사합니다. 다음에 또 이용해 주세요.
chinese_reference: 感谢您入住本旅馆。欢迎下次再来。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Thank you for staying with us. Please come again.

original: 사실, 이곳에 이 물과 에스메랄다 님이 아니면 이 마을에 사는 보람이 없지...
chinese_reference: 说真的，如果不是这里的水和埃斯梅拉达，住在这个村子里也没什么盼头……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Honestly, without this water and Esmeralda, there would be nothing worth living here for...

original: 전에 우리 마을에 사는 일가족이 마을 밖으로 도망 갔어요.
chinese_reference: 前些日子，我们村里有一家人逃走了。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: A family from our village fled a while ago.

original: 마녀 재판의 위기였기 때문이었기도 하지만, 그 집의 부인이 라몬 자작의 눈에 뜨인것이 가장 큰 원인이었죠...
chinese_reference: 一方面是为了躲避魔女审判，但最主要的原因，还是那家的妻子被拉蒙子爵看上了……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: They were facing a witch trial, but the main reason was that the wife had caught Viscount Ramon's eye...

original: 난, 결코, 절대로, 이따위 세상을 그냥 놔두지 않겠어!
chinese_reference: 我绝对、绝对不会对这种世道坐视不管！
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: I will never, ever let this wretched world go on like this!

original: 우리 친척 일가가, 라몬 자작의 손에서 도망가기 위해 이 고장을 버렸다... 지금은 생사도 몰라. 왜, 왜 힘이 없는 사람은 당해야 하지?
chinese_reference: 我的亲戚一家为了逃出拉蒙子爵的魔掌，离开了故乡……如今生死不明。为什么，为什么没力量的人就只能任人欺凌？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: My relatives abandoned their home to escape Viscount Ramon... I don't even know if they're alive. Why? Why must the powerless suffer?

original: 라몬자작의 여성편력은 유명하지요. 도대체 이 마을에 에스메랄다님이 안계시다면 어떤 마을이 될지...?
chinese_reference: 拉蒙子爵的好色是出了名的。要是没有埃斯梅拉达，这村子究竟会变成什么样……？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Viscount Ramon's womanizing is notorious. What would this village be like without Esmeralda...?

original: 얼마 전에도 일가족이 라몬 자작을 피해 도망쳤답니다. 라몬 자작은 군대로 그 일가의 뒤를 쫓았죠.
chinese_reference: 前不久，又有一家人为躲拉蒙子爵而逃走。拉蒙子爵派军队追了上去。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Just recently, another family fled from Viscount Ramon. He sent his troops after them.

original: 이 길로 가끔 고급 귀족의 마차가 지나곤 합니다.
chinese_reference: 这条路偶尔会有显贵的马车经过。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: High-ranking nobles' carriages sometimes pass along this road.

original: 우리 마을은 예로부터 경관이 수려하기 때문에 많은 귀족들이 서로 영주가 되려 하는 고장이죠.
chinese_reference: 我们村子自古风景秀丽，许多贵族都争着想当这里的领主。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Our village has always been known for its beauty. Many nobles compete to become its lord.

original: 이곳이 이번 작전의 목표중 하나인 프리토리아이다./n어서 저택을 공격하도록 하자.
chinese_reference: 这里就是本次作战目标之一，普雷托利亚。/n赶快进攻宅邸吧。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: This is Pretoria, one of our objectives in this operation./nLet's attack the mansion at once.

original: 칼을 다룰때 중요한 것은, 무기에 집착하면 안된다는 것일세. 무기는 어디까지나 검술을 위한 도구일뿐 그 목적이 아니야.
chinese_reference: 用剑最重要的，是不能执着于武器。武器终究只是施展剑术的工具，而非目的。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The important thing in swordsmanship is not to become attached to your weapon. A weapon is merely a tool for swordsmanship, not its purpose.

original: 궁극적으로 칼이 없어도 검술을 펼칠 수 있는 것이 경지 아니겠나! 무기에 연연하지 말게나!
chinese_reference: 最高的境界，不就是即使手中无剑，也能施展剑术吗！不要拘泥于武器！
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Isn't true mastery the ability to practice swordsmanship even without a sword? Don't cling to your weapon!

original: 외국어를 할 때는 그 나라 사람처럼 생각하고 말해야 해요.
chinese_reference: 说外语的时候，要像那个国家的人一样思考和表达。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: When you speak a foreign language, you must think and speak as its people do.

original: 요사이 점점 투르족의 말을 배우는 사람이 늘어나고 있어요.
chinese_reference: 最近学习图尔族语言的人越来越多了。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: More and more people are learning the Tur language these days.

original: 그 쪽과도 언젠가는 전쟁이 끝날 테고, 그렇게 되면 투르족의 말이 필요하게 될 테지요.
chinese_reference: 和他们的战争总有一天会结束，到那时，就需要用上图尔族的语言了。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The war with them will end someday, and then we will need the Tur language.

original: 도망치지 말아요. 도망치는 것은 문제를 해결 할 수 없어요.
chinese_reference: 不要逃避。逃避解决不了问题。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Don't run away. Running away won't solve anything.

original: 우리 마을의 영주님은 상당히 이상한 분이시라.... 이 곳에서는 살기 어렵다는 것이 진실이죠.
chinese_reference: 我们村子的领主是个相当古怪的人……说实话，这里的日子很难过。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Our lord is a rather peculiar man... The truth is, life here is difficult.

original: 고무줄을 너무 오래 당기고 있었더니 끊어져 버렸어요!
chinese_reference: 橡皮筋拉得太久，结果断掉了！
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: I stretched my rubber band for too long, and it snapped!

original: 그 고무줄이 제 다리를 쳤는데, 눈물이 쏙 빠질 정도로 따끔했어요!
chinese_reference: 断掉的橡皮筋抽到我腿上，疼得我眼泪都出来了！
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: It hit my leg and stung so badly that it brought tears to my eyes!

original: [ 실리아 ]/n어서오세요. 우리 상점에서 찾으시는 물건이 있나요?
chinese_reference: [ 西莉娅 ]/n欢迎光临。您想在本店找些什么？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: [ Celia ]/nWelcome. Is there something you need from our shop?

original: 저희 마을에 오신것은 행운입니다. 안녕히 가세요...
chinese_reference: 来到我们村，是您的好运。请慢走……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: You're fortunate to have come to our village. Farewell...

original: 라몬자작은 자신의 저택 2층에 막대한 재보를 모아 놓았다고 하던데...
chinese_reference: 听说拉蒙子爵在宅邸二楼囤了大量财宝……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: I hear Viscount Ramon has amassed a vast treasure on the second floor of his mansion...

original: 혹자는 그 특성에 따라 세검과 중검으로도 구분하는 모양입니다만.... 어찌되었든 살아남기 위해서라면 세검보다 중검이 좋지요. 세검을 사용하면, 이쪽이 때리는 것 만큼이나 공격당할 위험이 높으니까, 여간한 레벨이 아니고는 전투에서 살아남기가 힘들지요...
chinese_reference: 也有人按特性，把剑分为细剑和重剑……不管怎样，要想活下来，重剑比细剑更合适。使用细剑时，打出攻击的同时，挨打的风险也很高。如果等级不够高，就很难在战斗中活下来……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Some also classify swords as light or heavy, depending on their properties... In any case, heavy swords are better for survival. With a light sword, you're just as likely to be hit as to land a blow. Unless your level is quite high, it's hard to survive a battle...

original: Chry. 기리엄이나 바스타드 소드 같은 중검류의 무기를 사용하는 것이 당신의 목숨부지에 도움을 줄 것입니다. 특히나 강한 적과 맞붙게 된다면 말이죠.
chinese_reference: 使用克律萨俄耳·吉利安或手半剑之类的重剑，会更有助于保住性命。尤其是在面对强敌的时候。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: A heavy sword such as Chry. Gilliam or a Bastard Sword will help keep you alive, especially against a powerful enemy.

original: 검은 크게 방어형,공격형으로 나뉩니다.방어형은 칼의 내구성은 뛰어나지만, 공격력이 약하고,반대로 공격형은 쉽게 망가지는 반면, 공격력이 상당히 세지요.
chinese_reference: 剑大体分为防御型和攻击型。防御型耐用，却攻击力弱；攻击型则正好相反，虽然容易损坏，攻击力却很强。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Swords fall broadly into defensive and offensive types. Defensive swords are durable but weak in attack. Offensive swords break easily, but hit very hard.

original: 대표적인 방어형 검은 Chry.기리엄과 바스타드 소드입니다. 그리고 대표적인 공격형 검은 카산드라와 그람입니다.
chinese_reference: 代表性的防御剑是克律萨俄耳·吉利安和手半剑。代表性的攻击剑则是卡珊德拉和格拉姆。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Chry. Gilliam and the Bastard Sword are typical defensive swords. Cassandra and Gram are typical offensive swords.

original: 바스타드 소드는 상당히 튼튼하기 때문에 유지비가 적게드는 것이 장점이지요.
chinese_reference: 手半剑十分结实，优点是维护费用低。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The Bastard Sword is very sturdy, so its upkeep is inexpensive.

original: 그람은 공격력은 강력하지만 내구성이 약해서 상당한 유지비를 감수해야 합니다. 게다가 전투중 아군의 체력소모도 심하게 되서 회복약도 상당히 필요하지요.
chinese_reference: 格拉姆攻击力强，却不耐用，必须承担相当高的维护费用。而且，战斗中我方体力消耗也会很大，因此需要准备不少恢复药。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Gram hits hard but lacks durability, so you must accept high upkeep costs. Your party also loses a lot of health in battle, requiring plenty of healing potions.

original: 저, 이런 이야기 아세요? 얼마전에도 뛰어난 검사가 용의 굴을 탐험하러 들어갔었는데, 도중에 무기가 망가져서 결국...살아서 돌아오지 못했데요. 역시 무기는 튼튼한게 가장 좋은걸까요?
chinese_reference: 你听过这个故事吗？前不久，有个出色的剑士进入龙的洞窟探险，可武器在途中损坏了，结果……再也没能活着回来。果然，武器还是结实最重要吗？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Have you heard this story? Not long ago, a skilled swordsman went exploring a dragon's cave, but his weapon broke along the way. In the end... he never returned alive. Perhaps durability really is what matters most in a weapon?

original: 그람은 쓰는이에 따라 최강의 검으로 바뀔 수 있습니다. 비록 세검이라 방어는 힘들고, 날이 쉽게 빠지지만 위력은 유명한 명검들 못지 않거든요.
chinese_reference: 格拉姆在合适的人手中，可以成为最强的剑。虽然属于细剑，难以防御，剑刃也容易受损，但威力并不逊于那些著名的宝剑。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: In the right hands, Gram can become the strongest sword of all. As a light sword, it's hard to defend with and its edge chips easily, but its power rivals the most famous blades.

original: 우리 학술원 산하 검 연구회 사람들은 점점 잊혀져가는 무기인 검의 매력을 사람들에게 알리고 그것을 연구하는데 모든 정열을 바치고 있습니다.
chinese_reference: 我们学术院下属的剑术研究会，致力于研究剑这种逐渐被遗忘的武器，向人们展示它的魅力，为此倾注了全部热情。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: We in the Academy's Sword Research Society devote all our passion to studying swords and showing people the appeal of this increasingly forgotten weapon.

original: 전투에서 중요한 것은 적을 죽이는 것이 목적이 아니라, 내가 살아남는 것이지요. 갑옷류가 유명무실해진 지금에 와서 몸을 지키는 것은 검에 달려있답니다.
chinese_reference: 战斗的重点，不是杀死敌人，而是让自己活下来。如今铠甲已经形同虚设，能否保护身体，就取决于手中的剑。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The goal of battle is to survive, not to kill your enemy. Now that armor has become all but useless, your protection depends on your sword.

original: 세검류는 통쾌한 공격력을 자랑하긴 하지만, 자신의 HP에 상당한 부담을 안고 싸우게 됩니다. 목숨을 걸고 싸우는 것이라 할까요...?
chinese_reference: 细剑虽然攻击起来痛快，却会给自己的HP带来很大压力。可以说是在拿命战斗吧……？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Light swords boast exhilarating attack power, but put considerable strain on your HP. You could say you're gambling with your life...

original: 게다가 세검은 내구도가 약해서, 치열한 전투가 연속적으로 발생하게 되면 다 부숴져 적과 맨손으로 싸워야 하는 경우가 생길지도 몰라요. 그런 경우는 자살행위와 같지요.
chinese_reference: 而且细剑耐久度低，若激战接连不断，可能全都损坏，最后只能赤手空拳面对敌人。那就和自杀没什么两样了。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: What's more, light swords aren't durable. In a series of fierce battles, they may all break, leaving you to fight barehanded. That would be suicide.

original: 게이시르 학술원산하 제국지리학회 지부가 이 마을 서쪽에 있음
chinese_reference: 盖西尔学术院下属帝国地理学会分部位于村庄西侧。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: A branch of the Gaysir Academy's Imperial Geographical Society is located in the west of this village.

original: 프리토리아: 중급의 마을. 비교적 싼 물가. 유명한 여의사 에스메랄다의 고장. 이 근처의 산은 지형이 복잡하고 넓은 것으로 유명하다. 또한 유명한 피닉스의 동굴이 근처에 있으나 위험한 장소이기 때문에 정확한 위치는 밝혀두지 않는다. 단, 피닉스의 동굴 내부에서는 화염계열 최강마법을 구할 수도 있다고 한다./n- 게이시르 학술원 산하 제국지리학회 -
chinese_reference: 普雷托利亚：中等规模村庄，物价较低，著名女医生埃斯梅拉达的居所。附近山地以地形复杂、范围广阔著称。著名的不死鸟洞窟也在附近，但因其十分危险，故不公布确切位置。据说，在不死鸟洞窟内部，有可能获得最强的火焰系魔法。/n——盖西尔学术院下属帝国地理学会——
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Pretoria: A medium-sized village with relatively low prices, home to the famous physician Esmeralda. The surrounding mountains are known for their vast, intricate terrain. The famous Phoenix Cave is also nearby, but its exact location is withheld because of the danger. It is said that the strongest fire magic can be found inside./n- Imperial Geographical Society, Gaysir Academy -

original: 서부에 있는 지리학회 사람들을 본 적이 있어요? 허구한날 지도만 보고 다니는 이상한 사람들이랍니다.
chinese_reference: 你见过西边地理学会的人吗？那些怪人整天就知道盯着地图。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Have you seen the Geographical Society members in the west? Strange people, forever poring over maps.

original: 세상에, 그렇게 할일이 없는 사람들도 밥을 먹고 살고 있다니... 우리는 뼈빠지게 일해야 근근히 먹고살 수 있는데...
chinese_reference: 真是的，连那种整天无所事事的人，都能有饭吃……我们却得累死累活，才勉强糊口……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Honestly, even people with so little to do can feed themselves... We have to work ourselves to the bone just to scrape by...

original: 이게 다 흑태자님이 돌아가신 이후에 이 제국이 살만하지 못한 곳이 되었다는 증거에요. 우리도 강력한 지도자가 이곳을 다시 통일하길 원해요...
chinese_reference: 这不就证明，黑太子去世以后，这个帝国已经不适合过日子了吗？我们也盼着有位强有力的领袖，重新统一这里……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: It just proves that this empire has become unlivable since the Black Prince died. We want a strong leader to unite it again...

original: -프리토리아 마을 안내-/n주점:서북쪽/n아이템상점:서쪽/n여관:동북쪽/n무기상점:동쪽/n에스메랄다님의 병원: 마을 서부/n제국지리학회: 마을 서부
chinese_reference: ——普雷托利亚村指南——/n酒馆：西北/n道具店：西/n旅馆：东北/n武器店：东/n埃斯梅拉达医院：村西/n帝国地理学会：村西

original: 어서오세요. 우리 주점의 술맛은 세계 제일입니다.
chinese_reference: 欢迎光临。我们酒馆的酒，可是世界第一。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Welcome. Our tavern serves the finest drink in the world.

original: 우리마을에는 유명한 여의사 에스메랄다님이 사십니답니다.
chinese_reference: 我们村里住着有名的女医生埃斯梅拉达小姐。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The famous physician Esmeralda lives in our village.

original: [ 미스 바튼 ]/n 어서오세요, 유명한 에스메랄다 님이 계신 마을에 잘 오셨습니다. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?
chinese_reference: [ 巴顿小姐 ]/n欢迎光临，欢迎来到著名的埃斯梅拉达所在的村庄。有什么可以帮您？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: [ Miss Barton ]/n Welcome to the village of the famous Esmeralda. How may I help you?

original: 안녕히 가세요. 저희 가게에 들러 주셔서 감사합니다. 에스메랄다 님의 축복이 있기를.
chinese_reference: 请慢走。感谢惠顾本店。愿埃斯梅拉达祝福您。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Goodbye. Thank you for visiting our shop. May Esmeralda bless you.

original: [ 헤이든 양 ]/n어서오세요. 저희 여관에 오신것을 환영합니다. 묵으시겠습니까?
chinese_reference: [ 海登小姐 ]/n欢迎光临本旅馆。您要住下吗？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: [ Miss Hayden ]/nHello. Welcome to our inn. Would you like to stay?

original: 저희 여관을 이용해 주셔서 감사합니다. 그럼 이만...
chinese_reference: 感谢您入住本旅馆。那么，再见……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Thank you for staying with us. Goodbye, then...

original: 마녀 재판의 위기였기 때문이었기도 하지만, 그 집의 부인이 라몬 자작의 눈에 뜨인것이 가장큰 원인이었죠...
chinese_reference: 一方面是为了躲避魔女审判，但最主要的原因，还是那家的妻子被拉蒙子爵看上了……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: They were facing a witch trial, but the main reason was that the wife had caught Viscount Ramon's eye...

original: 난, 결코, 절대로, 이따위 세상을 그냥 놔두지를 않겠어!
chinese_reference: 我绝对、绝对不会对这种世道坐视不管！
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: I will never, ever let this wretched world go on like this!

original: 라몬자작의 여성편력은 유명하지요. 도데체 이 마을에서 에스메랄다님이 안계시다면 어떤 마을이 될지...?
chinese_reference: 拉蒙子爵的好色是出了名的。要是没有埃斯梅拉达，这村子究竟会变成什么样……？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Viscount Ramon's womanizing is notorious. What would this village be like without Esmeralda...?

original: 얼마 전에도 일가족이 라몬 자작을 피해 도망쳤답니다. 라몬 자작은 그 일가를 군대로 뒤를 쫓았죠.
chinese_reference: 前不久，又有一家人为躲拉蒙子爵而逃走。拉蒙子爵派军队追了上去。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Just recently, another family fled from Viscount Ramon. He sent his troops after them.

original: 이 길로 가끔가다 고급 귀족의 마차가 지나가곤 합니다.
chinese_reference: 这条路偶尔会有显贵的马车经过。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: High-ranking nobles' carriages sometimes pass along this road.

original: 우리 마을은 예로부터 경관이 수려하기 때문에 많은 귀족들이 서로 영주가 되려고 하는 고장이죠.
chinese_reference: 我们村子自古风景秀丽，许多贵族都争着想当这里的领主。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Our village has always been known for its beauty. Many nobles compete to become its lord.

original: 칼을 다룰때 중요한 것은, 무기에 집착하면 안된다는 것일쎄. 무기는 어디까지나 검술을 위한 도구일뿐 그 목적이 아니야.
chinese_reference: 用剑最重要的，是不能执着于武器。武器终究只是施展剑术的工具，而非目的。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The important thing in swordsmanship is not to become attached to your weapon. A weapon is merely a tool for swordsmanship, not its purpose.

original: 외국어를 할 때는 그사람 처럼 생각하고 말해야 해요.
chinese_reference: 说外语的时候，要像那个国家的人一样思考和表达。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: When you speak a foreign language, you must think and speak like its speakers.

original: 그쪽과도 언젠가는 전쟁이 끝날 거고, 그렇게 되면 투르족의 말이 필요하게 될 것 같군요.
chinese_reference: 和他们的战争总有一天会结束，到那时，应该就需要用上图尔族的语言了。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The war with them will end someday, and I imagine we will need the Tur language then.

original: 우리 마을의 영주님은 상당히 이상한 분이시라.... 이곳에서 살기는 정말 어렵다는 것이 진실이지요.
chinese_reference: 我们村子的领主是个相当古怪的人……说实话，这里的日子很难过。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Our lord is a rather peculiar man... The truth is, life here is very difficult.

original: 우리마을에는 에스메랄다 양의 진료소가 있지요. 그 유명한... 왜 아시죠?
chinese_reference: 我们村里有埃斯梅拉达小姐的诊所。就是那位大名鼎鼎的……您知道吧？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Miss Esmeralda has a clinic in our village. The famous one... You know her, don't you?

original: 옛날부터 많은 사람들의 그녀의 아름다움을  혹은 진정한 봉사정신을 보기 위해서 오곤 했답니다.
chinese_reference: 很久以来，就有许多人慕名而来，或为一睹她的美貌，或为见证她真挚的奉献精神。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: People have long come here to see her beauty, or her true spirit of service.

original: 훗, 아무리 생각해봐도 이 고장은 멋진 고장이야.
chinese_reference: 呵，不管怎么想，这地方都很棒啊。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Heh. Whichever way you look at it, this is a wonderful place.

original: 큰일이에요, 요새는 정말 물가가 많이 올라가고 있어요...
chinese_reference: 这可怎么办，最近物价涨得实在太厉害了……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: This is terrible. Prices have been rising so much lately...

original: 가뜩이나 먹고 살기 힘든데... 이 단벌옷이라도 팔아야 할 것 같아요.
chinese_reference: 本来日子就已经很难过了……看来连这唯一的一身衣服都得卖掉。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: It's already hard enough to get by... I may have to sell even this, my only set of clothes.

original: 아이... 우리 오빠는 굉장히 아가씨들 한테 인기가 많아요.
chinese_reference: 哎呀……我哥哥很受姑娘们欢迎呢。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Oh... My big brother is very popular with the young ladies.

original: 오빠는 에스메랄다님의 집에서 의사수업을 받고 있었답니다.
chinese_reference: 哥哥以前在埃斯梅拉达小姐家里学医。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: My brother was studying medicine at Esmeralda's house.

original: 에스메랄다 님은 정말 천사같으세요! 목소리도 그렇고, 모습도 그렇고, 더군다나 아픈사람들을 고쳐주시잖아요!
chinese_reference: 埃斯梅拉达小姐真像天使一样！声音是，样子也是，而且还会给生病的人治病！
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Esmeralda is just like an angel! Her voice, her looks... And she heals sick people, too!

original: 나도 이담에 커서 에스메랄다 님과 같은 의사가 되고 싶어요!
chinese_reference: 我长大以后，也想当埃斯梅拉达小姐那样的医生！
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: When I grow up, I want to be a doctor like Esmeralda!

original: 에스메랄다님, 오랜만에 오시는 군요. 병원은 별일 없습니다. 더이상 진료를 하지 않으니까, 별로 관리할 일은 없네요....
chinese_reference: 埃斯梅拉达小姐，好久没回来了呢。医院一切都好。已经不再接诊，也没什么需要打理的了……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Esmeralda, it's been a while. The hospital is fine. Since we're no longer treating patients, there isn't much to look after...

original: 우리 어머니 아버지는 얼마전에 같이 하늘나라로 떠나셨데요. 삼촌이 그러셨어요.
chinese_reference: 叔叔说，我爸爸妈妈不久前一起去了天国。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: My uncle said Mommy and Daddy went to heaven together a little while ago.

original: 내가 삼촌한테 나도 어머니 아버지가 있는 곳으로 가고 싶다고 했더니 막 혼났어요. 삼촌 미워요.
chinese_reference: 我跟叔叔说，我也想去爸爸妈妈在的地方，结果被狠狠骂了一顿。我讨厌叔叔。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: I told my uncle I wanted to go where Mommy and Daddy are, and he scolded me. I hate him.

original: 어른들은 이상해요. 왜 꼭 우리들이 하려고 하는 일을 못하게 막는 것이지요?
chinese_reference: 大人真奇怪。为什么总要拦着我们，不让我们做想做的事呢？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Grown-ups are strange. Why do they always stop us from doing what we want?

original: 저애 부모들은 라몬자작 손에 의해서 죽었다고 해도 과언이 아니죠. 불쌍하게도...
chinese_reference: 说那孩子的父母死在拉蒙子爵手里，也一点都不为过。真可怜……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: It wouldn't be wrong to say that child's parents died at Viscount Ramon's hands. Poor things...

original: 하지만, 난 결혼도 하기 전인데 애를 떠맡게 되었으니.... 정말 빌어먹을 세상이에요.
chinese_reference: 可我连婚都还没结，就得接手照顾孩子……这世道真该死。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: But now I've been left with a child before I've even married... What a damned world.

original: 왜 저런 아이를 놔두고 부모가 세상을 떠야 하는 것일까요? 과연 있는 자들은 없는 자들을 마음껏 괴롭히고 심지어 죽여도 된다는 것인가?
chinese_reference: 为什么父母非得丢下这么小的孩子离世呢？难道有钱有势的人，就能任意欺凌穷人，甚至杀了他们吗？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Why must parents die and leave a child like that behind? Are the rich allowed to torment the poor however they like, even kill them?

original: 에스메랄다 님은 정말 신의 현신이라는 말이 옳은 것 같아요.
chinese_reference: 说埃斯梅拉达小姐是神的化身，我看真没错。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: I think it's true what they say: Esmeralda is a god incarnate.

original: 그 인물에, 마음씨도 고우시고 게다가 돈이 없는 사람은 무료로도 치료해 주시지 않아요?
chinese_reference: 她那么美，心地又善良，而且还会给没钱的人免费治病，不是吗？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: She's beautiful and kind, and she even treats people for free if they have no money, doesn't she?

original: 우리마을에 지도를 대단히 좋아하는 사람들이 있어요. 저도 지도를 굉장히 좋아하는데....
chinese_reference: 我们村里有几个人特别喜欢地图。我也很喜欢地图……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Some people in our village adore maps. I'm very fond of maps myself...

original: 전설적인 지리학자 라르고 씨에 대해서 들어본 적이 있나요? 그는 실버애로우 사람이면서도 후생을 구 제국령에서 보내면서 제국령 지도제작에 몸을 바친사람이랍니다.
chinese_reference: 您听说过传说中的地理学家拉尔戈吗？他虽然是银箭的人，却在旧帝国领土度过了后半生，毕生致力于绘制帝国地图。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Have you heard of the legendary geographer Largo? Though he came from the Silver Arrow, he spent his later years in the former imperial lands, devoting himself to mapping them.

original: 사실상 제국에 알려진 지도의 초안은 그사람이 잡았다고 해도 과언이 아니죠.
chinese_reference: 可以说，帝国如今流传的地图，最初的底稿都是他绘制的。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: It's no exaggeration to say he drew the first drafts of virtually every map known in the empire.

original: 에스메랄다님의 제자분들은 지금 전원 고향에 내려가서 선생님의 뜻을 실현라고 있습니다.
chinese_reference: 埃斯梅拉达大人的弟子们，如今都已回到各自的故乡，实践老师的志向。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: All of Esmeralda's students have returned to their hometowns to carry out her wishes.

original: 단지, 선생님의 제자분들이 전국에 흩어져서 봉사활동을 펼치고 있으니 가장 가까운 곳을 가시면 되요.
chinese_reference: 不过，老师的学生们散布在全国各地，都在为人义诊，您去最近的一处就行。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Her students are doing charitable work all over the country, so you can visit whichever is nearest.

original: 지금은 비록 안계시지만... 그 자비의 정신은 아직도 계속되고 있답니다.
chinese_reference: 虽然她如今已经不在这里……那份仁慈之心，仍然在延续。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Though she is no longer here... her spirit of compassion lives on.

original: 이게 다 게이시르 전역이 불안해 져서 그래요. 제피르팰컨은 왜 전국을 불안하게 하고 있는 것이죠?
chinese_reference: 都怪整个盖西尔都不安宁了。西风之隼为什么要搅得全国不得安生？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: It's all because Gaysir is in turmoil. Why are the Zephyr Falcons unsettling the whole country?

original: 지금은 더이상 이곳에 없어요. 선진의술을 배우기 위해서 팬드래건으로 유학갔답니다.
chinese_reference: 他现在已经不在这里了。为了学习先进的医术，去潘德拉根留学了。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: He's no longer here. He went to Pendragon to study advanced medicine.

original: 어제 우리 학교에서 아이들이 단체로 수업을 빠졌지요.
chinese_reference: 昨天，我们学校的孩子们集体逃课了。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Yesterday, the children at our school all skipped class together.

original: 다른 친구들은 전부 지방으로 돌아갔습니다. 모두 잘 도착해서 잘 지내고 있다는 연락이 왔습니다.
chinese_reference: 其他同学都回各地去了。大家都传信来说，已经平安抵达，一切安好。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: All the others have returned to their regions. They've all sent word that they arrived safely and are doing well.

original: 저는.... 저는.... 선생님이 이 마을로 돌아오실 때 까지 이곳에서 기다리고 있겠습니다.
chinese_reference: 我……我……会留在这里，等老师回到这个村子。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: I... I... will wait here until you return to this village, Doctor.

original: 어서오세요, 에스메랄다님. 함께계신 분들에게는 특별히 싼 값에 물건을 드릴께요.
chinese_reference: 欢迎光临，埃斯梅拉达小姐。与您同行的各位，我会特地给个优惠价。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Welcome, Esmeralda. I'll give your companions a special discount.

original: 안녕히 가세요, 에스메랄다님. 몸조리 잘 하시고요.... 언젠가 돌아오실날을 기다리고 있겠습니다.
chinese_reference: 慢走，埃斯梅拉达小姐。请保重身体……我们会一直等着您回来的那一天。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Goodbye, Esmeralda. Take care of yourself... I'll be waiting for the day you return.

original: 진정으로 생활력이 강한 사람들은 일을 가리지 않고 하지.
chinese_reference: 真正能谋生的人，不会挑拣工作。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: People who really know how to make a living aren't picky about work.

original: 제피르 팰컨 기지 아래쪽에 있는 숲은 옛날부터 이상한 일이 많이 있기로 유명했지.
chinese_reference: 西风之隼基地下方的森林，自古就以怪事频发而闻名。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The forest below the Zephyr Falcons' base has long been famous for strange happenings.

original: 이 근처에는 옛날부터 상당히 많은 동굴들이 있지요. 동굴마다 많은 전설이 내려오는데, 그 전설이 하나같이 보물에 관련된 것이랍니다.
chinese_reference: 这附近自古就有很多洞穴。每个洞穴都流传着许多传说，而那些传说，无一例外都与宝藏有关。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: There have always been many caves around here. Each has its own legends, and every one of those legends concerns treasure.

original: 에스메랄다님의 제자분들은 지금 전원 고향에 내려가서 선생님의 뜻을 실현하고 있습니다.
chinese_reference: 埃斯梅拉达小姐的学生们，如今都已回到故乡，实践老师的志愿。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: All of Esmeralda's students have returned to their hometowns to carry out her wishes.

original: 에스메랄다님의 제자분들은 지금 전원 고향에 내려가서 선생님의 뜻을 실현하고 있습니다.
chinese_reference: 埃斯梅拉达小姐的学生们，如今都已回到故乡，实践老师的志愿。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: All of Esmeralda's students have returned to their hometowns to carry out her wishes.

original: 돈을 벌기 위해서는 어떤 일이라도 하겠다는 듯이 덤벼들어... 정말이지 이 동네는 너무 가난해.
chinese_reference: 为了赚钱，什么活都愿意扑上去干……唉，这地方实在太穷了。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: They throw themselves into any job if it pays... This village really is too poor.

original: 제국지리학회 프리토리아 지부/n지리에 어두운 모든 사람을 도와드립니다. 저희는 공공기금으로 운영되는 "제국학술원"재단산하 소속입니다.
chinese_reference: 帝国地理学会普雷托利亚分部/n帮助每一位不熟悉地理的人。我们隶属于由公共基金运营的“帝国学术院”基金会。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Imperial Geographical Society, Pretoria Branch/nWe help anyone unfamiliar with geography. We belong to the publicly funded Imperial Academy foundation.

original: 구제국령을 길을 잃지않고 다니기 위해서는 역시 숲의 길을 파악하는 것이 중요하지. 숲의 길만 파악하면 제국의 지리를 반을 알았다해도 과언이 아니야.
chinese_reference: 想在旧帝国领土行走而不迷路，关键还是要摸清森林里的道路。只要熟悉林间小径，说你掌握了帝国一半的地理也不为过。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: To travel the former imperial lands without getting lost, you must know the forest paths. Master those, and you could say you know half the empire's geography.

original: 단적으로, 로우엔과 보르도 사이의 숲은 남북으로는 도시와 연결되어 있지만, 오른쪽으로 빠지게 되면 마검숲이란 미로숲으로 빠지게된단 말이야.
chinese_reference: 举个例子，罗恩与波尔多之间的森林，南北两端都通往城市，但若朝右边走，就会进入名为魔剑森林的迷宫。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: For example, the forest between Lowen and Bordeaux connects to towns in the north and south. But turn right, and you'll enter a maze called the Demon Sword Forest.

original: 게이시르와 로우엔 사이는 상당히 복잡한 숲이 놓여져 있다네. 게이시르 숲은 표지판도 적은 편이고, 더군다나 동쪽으로는 니코시아 남으로는 멤피스랑 연결이 되고, 서쪽으로 가면 로우엔 방향이기는 하지만, 중간에 다시 산을 건너야 하지. 상당히 어려운 길이야...
chinese_reference: 盖西尔和罗恩之间隔着一片相当复杂的森林。盖西尔森林里的路标不多，而且东面通往尼科西亚，南面通往孟菲斯。往西虽然是罗恩的方向，可中途还得再翻过一座山。那条路相当难走啊……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: A very confusing forest lies between Gaysir and Lowen. Gaysir Forest has few signposts. It connects to Nicosia in the east and Memphis in the south. West leads toward Lowen, but you still have to cross a mountain along the way. It's a difficult journey...

original: 카라카스 근처의 숲의 특징은 상당히 많은 지방과 연결이 된다는 점에 있습니다. 북쪽으로는 리브레빌, 남으로는 게이시르 시티, 동으로는 파로마을과 트리시스 사막이 있고 서쪽으로는 이곳, 프리토리아와 통하지요. 한마디로 게이시르시티 북부의 교통의 요지라고 생각하시면 될 거에요.
chinese_reference: 加拉加斯附近的森林，特点就是连接着许多地方。北面是利伯维尔，南面是盖西尔城，东面是帕罗村和特里西斯沙漠，西面则通往这里，普雷托利亚。简单说，把它看作盖西尔城北部的交通要地就行了。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The forest near Caracas connects to many regions. Libreville lies north, Gaysir City south, Paro Village and the Trisis Desert east, and Pretoria here to the west. Think of it as a major crossroads north of Gaysir City.

original: 따라서 카라카스 근처의 숲에서는 갈림길에서 갈려 나가는 모든 길이 각각 다른 지방으로 통하는 길이라고 생각하셔도 무방합니다.
chinese_reference: 所以，在加拉加斯附近的森林里，可以认为每条岔路都通往不同的地区。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: So in the forest near Caracas, you can assume every fork leads to a different region.

original: 카라카스에서 나와 계속 남쪽으로만 가면 파로가 나오고, 남쪽으로 가다가 서쪽으로 꺾은다음 다시 남쪽으로 가면 게이시르 시티가, 남쪽으로 가다가 서쪽으로, 그리고 다시 북쪽으로 가서 동북쪽으로 가면 리브레빌 지방으로 가게 되죠. 물론, 카라카스와 이곳 프리토리아 사이 길은 아시겠지요?
chinese_reference: 离开加拉加斯后一直向南，就能到帕罗；向南走后转向西，再转向南，就能到盖西尔城；先向南，再向西，接着向北，再往东北走，就能到利伯维尔地区。当然，加拉加斯与这里普雷托利亚之间的路，您应该知道吧？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Leave Caracas and keep south to reach Paro. Go south, turn west, then south again for Gaysir City. Go south, west, north, then northeast to reach the Libreville region. Of course, you know the road between Caracas and Pretoria here, don't you?

original: 우리 마을에서 나가셔서 계속 북쪽으로 가시면 피닉스 동굴을 발견할 수 있을 것입니다. 그 유명한...
chinese_reference: 出了我们村子后一直向北，就能找到凤凰洞穴。就是那个很有名的……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Leave our village and keep heading north, and you'll find Phoenix Cave. The famous one...

original: 마을에서 나가 서쪽으로 가다가 남서쪽으로 꺾어지면 드래건 브레스 산맥 남단으로 접어들지요. 그곳은 예로부터 많은 저항세력들이 있던 곳입니다. 또한 드레건 브레스 산맥 남단에서는 한 이름없는 동굴로 이어지는데, 동굴안에는 값나가는 보물이 많다고 합니다.
chinese_reference: 出村后往西走，再转向西南，就进入龙息山脉南端了。那里自古以来就有许多抵抗势力活动。龙息山脉南端还通往一座无名洞窟，据说洞里藏着不少值钱的宝物。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Leave the village heading west, then turn southwest to enter the southern Dragon's Breath Mountains. Many resistance groups have long been based there. The southern mountains also lead to an unnamed cave said to hold many valuable treasures.

original: 그 동굴은 드래건 브레스 산맥 남단의 서쪽 끝에 있다고 알려져 있지요.
chinese_reference: 据说那个洞穴，就在龙息山脉南端的最西边。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: That cave is said to lie at the western end of the southern Dragon's Breath Mountains.

original: 게이시르시티 남쪽의 게이시르 숲은, 현재는 게이시르시의 관리소홀로 표지판이 부족하지만, 상당히 넓고 이곳저곳 통한 곳이 많은, 남부의 교통의 요지라고 할 수 있지.
chinese_reference: 盖西尔城南面的盖西尔森林，如今因为市政疏于管理，路标不足。不过森林相当广阔，又通往许多地方，可以说是南部的交通要地。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Gaysir Forest, south of Gaysir City, lacks signposts because of the city's neglect. But it's vast and connects to many places, making it a major crossroads in the south.

original: 게이시르 시티에서 나와서 계속 남쪽으로 가면 멤피스 마을, 남쪽으로 가다가 동북쪽으로 꺾어 올라가면 니코시아 교회요새로, 남쪽으로 가다가 서북쪽으로 꺾으면 로우엔으로 가는 길이지. 하긴, 로우엔으로 가는 길과 화룡굴로 가는 길이 헷갈릴 수도 있겠군...
chinese_reference: 离开盖西尔城后一直向南，就是孟菲斯村；向南走，再转向东北，就能到尼科西亚教会要塞；向南走，再转向西北，就是去罗恩的路。不过，前往罗恩的路和前往火龙洞的路，倒是很容易弄混……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Keep south from Gaysir City to reach Memphis Village. Go south, then northeast for Nicosia Church Fortress. Go south, then northwest for Lowen. Though you might confuse the road to Lowen with the one to Fire Dragon Cave...

original: 게이시르에서 로우엔을 가기는 쉽지않지. 게이시르 시티에서 내려와 두번째 갈림길에서 서북쪽으로 간 뒤에 계속 서쪽으로 방향을 잡고 전진해야 하네. 그 숲들은 상당히 복잡하지...
chinese_reference: 从盖西尔去罗恩可不容易。从盖西尔城往南走，在第二个岔路口转向西北，之后一直朝西前进。那些森林里的路相当复杂……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Getting from Gaysir to Lowen isn't easy. Head south from Gaysir City, take the second fork northwest, then keep heading west. Those forests are very confusing...

original: 전 지리학회 소속이에요. "비프로스트 접경지대의 지리와 사람들의 삶의 변화형태의 미분적고찰"이란 논문으로 박사학위를 받았지요.
chinese_reference: 我是地理学会的成员，凭借《对比弗罗斯特边境地区地理与居民生活变化形态的微分考察》这篇论文获得了博士学位。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: I'm a member of the Geographical Society. I earned my doctorate with a thesis titled "A Differential Study of the Geography and Changing Patterns of Life in the Bifrost Borderlands."

original: 리브레빌은 게이시르 시티에서 계속 북쪽으로 가다가 동쪽의 다리를 건너서 다시 북쪽으로 가면 나오지요.
chinese_reference: 从盖西尔城一直往北，过了东面的桥后再向北，就能到利伯维尔。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Keep heading north from Gaysir City, cross the bridge to the east, then head north again to reach Libreville.

original: 리브레빌에서 동북쪽으로 올라가면 안타나나리보 지방인데, 상당한 시골 산골 마을이에요. 리브레빌에서 가기 위해서는 리브레빌 근처의 숲에서 북쪽으로 올라가서 산악지대 첫번째 갈림길에서 서쪽으로 간 뒤 막바로 북쪽으로 꺾어서 쭉 올라가야 하지요.
chinese_reference: 从利伯维尔往东北，就是塔那那利佛地区，是个相当偏僻的山村。要从利伯维尔去那里，得先从附近的森林往北，抵达山区第一个岔路口后向西，再立刻转向北，一直走下去。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Northeast of Libreville lies Antananarivo, a very remote mountain village. From Libreville, go north through the nearby forest. At the first fork in the mountains, go west, immediately turn north, and keep going.

original: 아, 에스메랄다님. 아직도 사람들이 에스메랄다님을 찾아서 이곳으로 오곤 한답니다. 가까운 선생님의 제자가 운영하는 자선병원으로 가라고 해도 막무가내인 사람이 많아요.
chinese_reference: 啊，埃斯梅拉达小姐。如今仍有人为了找您，来到这里。即使劝他们去附近由您的学生开办的慈善医院，很多人也怎么都不听。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Ah, Esmeralda. People still come here looking for you. Many simply won't listen when we direct them to a nearby charity hospital run by one of your students.

original: 아직은 돌아오시지 않을 생각이십니까? ... 저도 에스메랄다님이 좀 자신을 위해서 살아보기를 바라고 있었습니다만...

original: 에스메랄다 님은 정말 신의 현신이라는 말이 옳은 것 같아요.

chinese_reference: 盖西尔与罗恩之间有一片道路十分复杂的/n森林。盖西尔森林的路标很少，/n而且东面通往尼科西亚，南面通往孟菲斯，/n往西虽然是罗恩的方向，/n途中却还得翻过一座山。那条路可不好走……

chinese_reference: 加拉加斯附近森林的特点，/n就是通往很多地区。/n北面是利伯维尔，南面是盖西尔城，/n东面是帕罗村和特里西斯沙漠，/n西面则通往这里——普雷托利亚。/n简单说，把它看作盖西尔城北部的/n交通要道就行。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The forest near Caracas/nconnects to many regions./nLibreville lies north, Gaysir City south,/nParo Village and the Trisis Desert east, /nand Pretoria here to the west./nThink of it as a major crossroads/nnorth of Gaysir City.

original: 따라서 카라카스 근처의 숲에서는 갈림길에서/n갈려 나가는 모든 길이 각각 다른 지방으로/n통하는 길이라고 생각하셔도 무방합니다.

original: 카라카스에서 나와 계속 남쪽으로만 가면 파로가 나오고,/n남쪽으로 가다가 서쪽으로 꺾은 다음 다시 남쪽으로/n가면 게이시르 시티가, 남쪽으로 가다가 서쪽으로,/n그리고 다시 북쪽으로 가서 동북쪽으로 가면/n리브레빌 지방으로 가게 되죠. 물론, 카라카스와/n이곳 프리토리아 사이 길은 아시겠지요?

original: 우리 마을에서 나가셔서 계속 북쪽으로 가시면/n피닉스 동굴을 발견할 수 있을 것입니다. 그 유명한…

notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.

target: We in the Academy's Sword Research Society devote all our passion/nto studying swords and showing people the appeal/nof this increasingly forgotten weapon.

original: 전투에서 중요한 것은 적을 죽이는 것이/n목적이 아니라, 내가 살아남는 것이지요./n갑옷류가 유명무실해진 지금에 와서/n몸을 지키는 것은 검에 달려 있답니다.
chinese_reference: 战斗的重点，不是杀死敌人，/n而是让自己活下来。/n如今铠甲已经形同虚设，/n能否保护身体，就取决于手中的剑。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The goal of battle is to survive,/nnot to kill your enemy./nNow that armor has become all but useless,/nyour protection depends on your sword.

original: 세검류는 통쾌한 공격력을 자랑하긴 하지만,/n자신의 HP에 상당한 부담을 안고 싸우게 됩니다./n목숨을 걸고 싸우는 것이라 할까요…?
chinese_reference: 细剑虽然攻击起来痛快，/n却会给自己的HP带来很大压力。/n可以说是在拿命战斗吧……？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Light swords boast exhilarating attack power,/nbut put considerable strain on your HP./nYou could say you're gambling with your life...

original: 게다가 세검은 내구도가 약해서, 치열한 전투가/n연속적으로 발생하게 되면 다 부서져 적과 맨손으로/n싸워야 하는 경우가 생길 지도 몰라요./n그런 경우는 자살 행위와 같지요.
chinese_reference: 而且细剑耐久度低，若激战/n接连不断，可能全都损坏，最后只能赤手空拳/n面对敌人。/n那就和自杀没什么两样了。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: What's more, light swords aren't durable. In a series/nof fierce battles, they may all break, leaving you/nto fight barehanded./nThat would be suicide.

original: 게이시르 학술원 산하 제국지리학회/n지부가 이 마을 서쪽에 있음
chinese_reference: 盖西尔学术院下属帝国地理学会/n分部位于村庄西侧。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: A branch of the Gaysir Academy's Imperial Geographical Society/nis located in the west of this village.

original: 프리토리아 : 중급의 마을. 비교적 싼 물가. 유명한 여의사 에스메랄다의 고장./n이 근처의 산은 지형이 복잡하고 넓은 것으로 유명하다./n또한 유명한 피닉스의 동굴이 근처에 있으나 위험한 장소이기 때문에 정확한 위치는 밝혀두지 않는다./n단, 피닉스의 동굴 내부에서는 화염계열 최강마법을 구할 수도 있다고 한다./n- 게이시르 학술원 산하 제국지리학회 -
chinese_reference: 普雷托利亚：中等规模村庄，物价较低，著名女医生埃斯梅拉达的居所。/n附近山地以地形复杂、范围广阔著称。/n著名的不死鸟洞窟也在附近，但因其十分危险，故不公布确切位置。/n据说，在不死鸟洞窟内部，有可能获得最强的火焰系魔法。/n——盖西尔学术院下属帝国地理学会——
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Pretoria: A medium-sized village with relatively low prices, home to the famous physician Esmeralda./nThe surrounding mountains are known for their vast, intricate terrain./nThe famous Phoenix Cave is also nearby, but its exact location is withheld because of the danger./nIt is said that the strongest fire magic can be found inside./n- Imperial Geographical Society, Gaysir Academy -

original: 서부에 있는 지리학회 사람들을 본 적이 있어요?/n허구한 날 지도만 보고 다니는 이상한 사람들이랍니다.
chinese_reference: 你见过西边地理学会的人吗？/n那些怪人整天就知道盯着地图。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Have you seen the Geographical Society members in the west?/nStrange people, forever poring over maps.

original: 세상에, 그렇게 할 일이 없는 사람들도/n밥을 먹고 살고 있다니…/n우리는 뼈 빠지게 일해야 근근히 먹고 살 수 있는데…
chinese_reference: 真是的，连那种整天无所事事的人，/n都能有饭吃……/n我们却得累死累活，才勉强糊口……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Honestly, even people with so little to do/ncan feed themselves.../nWe have to work ourselves to the bone just to scrape by...

original: 이게 다 흑태자님이 돌아가신 이후에/n이 제국이 살 만하지 못한 곳이 되었다는 증거에요./n우리도 강력한 지도자가 이곳을 다시 통일하길 원해요…
chinese_reference: 这不就证明，黑太子去世以后，/n这个帝国已经不适合过日子了吗？/n我们也盼着有位强有力的领袖，重新统一这里……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: It just proves that this empire has become unlivable/nsince the Black Prince died./nWe want a strong leader to unite it again...

original: 어서오세요. 우리 주점의 술 맛은 세계 제일입니다.
chinese_reference: 欢迎光临。我们酒馆的酒，可是世界第一。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Welcome. Our tavern serves the finest drink in the world.

original: 우리 마을에는 유명한 여의사 에스메랄다 님이 사신답니다.
chinese_reference: 我们村里住着著名女医生埃斯梅拉达。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The famous physician Esmeralda lives in our village.

original: [ 미스 바튼 ]/n 어서오세요, 유명한 에스메랄다 님이 계신 마을에 잘 오셨습니다. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?
chinese_reference: [ 巴顿小姐 ]/n欢迎光临，欢迎来到著名的埃斯梅拉达所在的村庄。有什么可以帮您？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: [ Miss Barton ]/n Welcome to the village of the famous Esmeralda. How may I help you?

original: 안녕히 가세요. 저희 가게에 들러 주셔서 감사합니다. 에스메랄다 님의 축복이 있기를.
chinese_reference: 请慢走。感谢惠顾本店。愿埃斯梅拉达祝福您。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Goodbye. Thank you for visiting our shop. May Esmeralda bless you.

original: [ 헤이든 양 ]/n어서오세요. 저희 여관에 오신것을 환영합니다. 묵으시겠습니까?
chinese_reference: [ 海登小姐 ]/n欢迎光临本旅馆。您要住下吗？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: [ Miss Hayden ]/nHello. Welcome to our inn. Would you like to stay?

original: 저희 여관을 이용해 주셔서 감사합니다. 그럼 이만…
chinese_reference: 感谢您入住本旅馆。那么，再见……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Thank you for staying with us. Goodbye, then...

original: 마녀 재판의 위기였기 때문이었기도 하지만, 그 집의 부인이 라몬 자작의 눈에 뜨인것이 가장큰 원인이었죠…
chinese_reference: 一方面是为了躲避魔女审判，但最主要的原因，还是那家的妻子被拉蒙子爵看上了……
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: They were facing a witch trial, but the main reason was that the wife had caught Viscount Ramon's eye...

original: 난, 결코, 절대로, 이따위 세상을 그냥 놔두지를 않겠어!
chinese_reference: 我绝对、绝对不会对这种世道坐视不管！
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: I will never, ever let this wretched world go on like this!

original: 라몬자작의 여성편력은 유명하지요. 도데체 이 마을에서 에스메랄다님이 안계시다면 어떤 마을이 될지…?
chinese_reference: 拉蒙子爵的好色是出了名的。要是没有埃斯梅拉达，这村子究竟会变成什么样……？
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Viscount Ramon's womanizing is notorious. What would this village be like without Esmeralda...?

original: 얼마 전에도 일가족이 라몬 자작을 피해 도망쳤답니다. 라몬 자작은 그 일가를 군대로 뒤를 쫓았죠.
chinese_reference: 前不久，又有一家人为躲拉蒙子爵而逃走。拉蒙子爵派军队追了上去。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Just recently, another family fled from Viscount Ramon. He sent his troops after them.

original: 이 길로 가끔가다 고급 귀족의 마차가 지나가곤 합니다.
chinese_reference: 这条路偶尔会有显贵的马车经过。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: High-ranking nobles' carriages sometimes pass along this road.

original: 우리 마을은 예로부터 경관이 수려하기 때문에 많은 귀족들이 서로 영주가 되려고 하는 고장이죠.
chinese_reference: 我们村子自古风景秀丽，许多贵族都争着想当这里的领主。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Our village has always been known for its beauty. Many nobles compete to become its lord.

original: 칼을 다룰때 중요한 것은, 무기에 집착하면 안된다는 것일쎄. 무기는 어디까지나 검술을 위한 도구일뿐 그 목적이 아니야.
chinese_reference: 用剑最重要的，是不能执着于武器。武器终究只是施展剑术的工具，而非目的。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The important thing in swordsmanship is not to become attached to your weapon. A weapon is merely a tool for swordsmanship, not its purpose.

original: 외국어를 할 때는 그사람 처럼 생각하고 말해야 해요.
chinese_reference: 说外语的时候，要像那个国家的人一样思考和表达。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: When you speak a foreign language, you must think and speak like its speakers.

original: 그쪽과도 언젠가는 전쟁이 끝날 거고, 그렇게 되면 투르족의 말이 필요하게 될 것 같군요.
chinese_reference: 和他们的战争总有一天会结束，到那时，应该就需要用上图尔族的语言了。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: The war with them will end someday, and I imagine we will need the Tur language then.

original: 우리 마을의 영주님은 상당히 이상한 분이시라…. 이곳에서 살기는 정말 어렵다는 것이 진실이지요.
chinese_reference: 我们村子的领主是个相当古怪的人……说实话，这里的日子很难过。
notes: Korean translated with Chinese checked alongside. Minor NPC names and geography remain provisional; directions and classic/remastered differences retained.
target: Our lord is a rather peculiar man... The truth is, life here is very difficult.
